body: I noticed we also check for the `dummy` renderer, but it's not relevant as the editor can't run with the dummy renderer in a way that node configuration warnings can be seen. I opened https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118573 for this.

`dummy` renderer can be selected (manually or as last resort fallback) for accessibility (to avoid unnecessary overhead on low-end systems when using in with screen reader, or run on a system without usable GPU), so editor should be able to run with it.

I see. I guess it's still better to not emit the warning in this case, as we can't assume the project is targeting the Compatibility renderer when using the dummy renderer.

Maybe we should check if the editor is using the dummy renderer *and* the renderer project setting is set to `gl_compatibility`. This would add some complexity and code duplication across warnings though.
